# Where each Tenth Edition command belongs.
#
# Generated by tools/v10-where.py; check with --check.  V10 has no
# shipped image to measure -- making one is B3 -- so this is assembled
# from documents.  The third column says which, and they are not of
# equal authority:
#
#   mk    the tape's OWN makefile install rule, quoted in
#         tools/v10-where.py.  The build stating what it does with
#         its own product, which is the rule we reimplement.
#   man   V10's own manual, section 8 SYNOPSIS.  Bell Labs stating it.
#   v8    v8/mk/where.txt, measured on a real V8 disk.  Inference from
#         the previous edition of the same system on the same machine.
#   --    neither.  UNRESOLVED, deliberately: a command installed to
#         the wrong directory is invisible until something cannot find
#         it, and by then the disk is built.
#
# fields: name<TAB>directory<TAB>source
#
# 5 from the tape's makefiles, 22 from the manual, 144 inferred from V8,
# 95 unresolved
#
